name: Imtron Electronics
old_description: Minnesota-based Imtron has supplied high-quality electronic components to manufacturers across the world since 1988.
about:
Imtron Electronics was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. The privately held company began as a supplier of high-quality electronic components to manufacturers across the United States and globally.

Operating as a stocking distributor, Imtron maintains inventory from a roster of supplier partners that includes LEMO connectors, Magtech LED drivers, TXC crystals, Henkel thermal management products, and Mornsun power supplies. The product range spans connectors, crystals, thermal management solutions, and power supplies, supported by a consultative sales approach and global logistics.

The company serves manufacturers in the automotive, aviation, medical, and military sectors. Its components are specified in applications where field failure is not an option, such as defense systems, medical devices, avionics, and increasingly electrified vehicles.

Imtron differentiates itself through a consultative model aimed at identifying cost-effective solutions for high-reliability requirements. The company cites its ISO 9001:2015 certification and a team with decades of component-sourcing experience as foundations for supporting critical applications.
